claims.quote: Rare variants in SOS2 and LZTR1 are associated with Noonan syndrome.
Rare variants in SOS2 and LZTR1 are associated with Noonan syndrome.
BACKGROUND: Noonan syndrome is an autosomal dominant, multisystemic disorder caused by dysregulation of the RAS/mitogen activated protein kinase (MAPK) pathway.
Notably, SOS2 variants were identified in patients with marked ectodermal involvement, similar to patients with SOS1 mutations.
CONCLUSIONS: We identified two novel genes, SOS2 and LZTR1, associated with Noonan syndrome, thereby expanding the molecular spectrum of RASopathies.
